passages.text:
Session date: 3:56 pm on 6 June, 2023
[D13:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Long time no talk - I had lots of stuff going on. Remember the tough engineering project? I finally wrapped that up last month. Look at the result!
[D13:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a solar powered vehicle with a solar panel on the back
[D13:2] Deborah: Jolene! Congrats on wrapping up your with it! You really put in the work and it paid off. 
[D13:3] Jolene:  I'm really proud of myself for sticking it out despite the problems and finishing it. It's definitely a big milestone.
[D13:4] Deborah: Now that you've reached this big milestone, what do you have planned next?
[D13:5] Jolene:  I'm interning at a well-known engineering firm. It's been a great opportunity to test my skills and gain real-world experience. These are my new colleagues!
[D13:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of construction workers posing for a picture
[D13:6] Deborah: What's been the best part of it so far?
[D13:7] Jolene: The best part so far has been being able to apply what I learned in school to real projects. It's so fulfilling to see my ideas come to life.
[D13:8] Deborah: Mind if I ask how the internship has impacted you?
[D13:9] Jolene: It has had a positive impact on my life. It has stoked my love of engineering and has encouraged me to keep striving for my dreams.
[D13:10] Deborah:  How has it inspired you to keep striving for your dreams?
[D13:11] Jolene: Hanging out with people who love what they do has really inspired me to stay focused and keep working towards my goals. It's shown me that with dedication and effort, anything is possible.
[D13:12] Deborah: Have you been able to find a good work-life balance during your internship?
[D13:13] Jolene: Honestly, finding that balance has been tough. I've been slogging away and it's been hard to make time for my hobbies and chilling out.
[D13:14] Deborah:  Have you considered taking some breaks and finding activities like yoga to help you relax and unwind? That might make a difference.
[D13:15] Jolene: Yeah, I`m trying to do it. Here's an example of how I spent yesterday morning, yoga on top of mount Talkeetna.
[D13:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man standing on a rock with his arms outstretched
[D13:16] Deborah: Nice job, Jolene! How long have you been doing yoga and meditation? It looks like it's really helping you regroup and recharge.
[D13:17] Jolene: I've been doing them sporadically for about 3 years now and they've had a real positive effect on me.
[D13:18] Deborah: Has it benefited you in any way? Have you found it helpful in difficult moments?
[D13:19] Jolene: It has helped me with stress and kept me centered.
[D13:20] Deborah: Glad they've been helpful for you!
[D13:21] Jolene: No idea how I would've survived without them!
[D13:22] Deborah: This is my favorite studio and it's always so calming. 
[D13:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a bench and a window
[D13:23] Jolene:  I was wondering if you have any advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga?
[D13:24] Deborah: I'd recommend practicing mindful breathing for yoga. Set aside a few minutes each day to sit with your eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on how the air feels entering and leaving your body. 
[D13:25] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! I'll definitely give it a try. Appreciate the advice!
[D13:26] Deborah:  If you need more tips or help, just let me know. Take care!
[D13:27] Jolene: See you!
Session date: 9:17 am on 26 June, 2023
[D14:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! How's it going? We haven't talked in a while. I've been busy getting ready for a yoga retreat with some buddies. A chance to hang out with people who think like me and find peace and understanding. Sounds awesome!
[D14:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park
[D14:2] Jolene: Hey Deb! Been super hectic with internship and stuff. That retreat sounds awesome, I could definitely use a break!
[D14:3] Deborah: By the way, I tried a new pose - Dancer Pose (Natarajasana). Rate, did I succeed?
[D14:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D14:4] Jolene: You are amazing as always! Here are new photos of Seraphim in the new aquarium that I bought the day before yesterday.
[D14:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake curled up in a plant filled area
[D14:5] Deborah: Where'd you get it? I'm always drawn to animals, they bring so much joy. What's its story?
[D14:6] Jolene:  I got her last year, she's a great pet. She always cheers me up and brings a sense of peace. Spending time with her is so comforting.
[D14:7] Deborah: Pets really do make life more enjoyable and bright. 
[D14:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a field
[D14:8] Jolene:  I'm so thankful it's here. Plus, it's nice to have a calm creature around.
[D14:9] Deborah: How have things been besides that?
[D14:10] Jolene: Things have been intense lately. I'm really pushing myself to succeed, and sometimes it feels overwhelming. But I'm determined to overcome any obstacles and achieve my goals.
[D14:11] Deborah: Keep up the hard work and remember to relax too.
[D14:12] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! I had a big breakthrough with this project - so exciting and rewarding!
[D14:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drawing of a house with a ruler and a ruler
[D14:13] Deborah: Awesome, Jolene! I'm really glad your project worked out. 
[D14:14] Jolene: Stop talking about me, tell me more about your retreat.
[D14:15] Deborah: I'd rather show you a photo. This is also a new yoga pose that we tried. It is a tree pose.
[D14:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of three people standing in front of a large statue
[D14:16] Jolene: What's that statue in the picture?
[D14:17] Deborah: It's a symbol of peace and enlightenment.
[D14:18] Jolene: Wow, it looks gorgeous! I'd love to visit a retreat like that. It seems like the ideal spot to find peace and refreshment.
[D14:19] Deborah: It's perfect for reflecting and getting centered.
[D14:20] Jolene: I could really use some chill time like that. Sounds so peaceful.
[D14:21] Deborah: Yeah, we all need some peaceful time to relax.
[D14:22] Jolene: Gotta run, have a nice day!
[D14:23] Deborah: See you!
[D14:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunset reflecting in a lake with a boat
Session date: 7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023
[D15:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! I started a running group with Anna - it's awesome connecting with people who care about fitness!
[D15:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of three men standing next to each other on a road
[D15:2] Jolene: Cool, Deb! Glad you found some people to get fit with. I'm trying to add workouts into my studying schedule, which has been tough but fun. How about you? Any challenges with the running group?
[D15:3] Deborah: Oh, I'm having a blast with it! We help and push each other during our runs, which makes it so much easier to stay motivated.  I have a lot of my photos from this activity.
[D15:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman standing on a sidewalk with a skateboard

passages.title: LoCoMo conv-48 history chunk 7
passages.text:
Session date: 7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023
[D15:4] Jolene: Deborah, that's awesome! Being part of a supportive group must be super motivating. Finding a team that's passionate about something makes a huge difference. Just thinking about my own journey too.
[D15:5] Deborah: Having people who can cheer you on and give you advice really makes a difference. What has it been like for you finding supportive folks?
[D15:6] Jolene: Gaming's been tough lately, but I'm grateful I have someone who's also into it. My partner helps me stay focused on our goals. We have a lot of cute photos, I want to share with you.
[D15:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer
[D15:7] Deborah:  What do you like best about gaming together?
[D15:8] Jolene: We get to tackle challenges and have a shared experience. It's always a blast when we're into the same game and achieve something tough. Plus, it's a great way to bond and get closer.
[D15:9] Deborah: Woah, that's cool! Gaming is so good for strengthening relationships. Do you two have a favorite game to play together?
[D15:10] Jolene: Yeah, we love playing "It takes two" together! It's a fun team-strategy game and it's competitive. Plus, it's a great way for us to bond. Do you have any activities you like doing with people?
[D15:11] Deborah: Yep, I do running and yoga/meditation with others. Connecting with people and creating a community is great. Plus, I love organizing workshops and events to practice mindfulness and self-care. It's an awesome way to have fun, build relationships, and support each other's growth.
[D15:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park
[D15:12] Jolene: Sounds like a great way to relax. What do your workshops and events involve?
[D15:13] Deborah: It involves various activities such as yoga, meditation, and self-reflection. They aim to cultivate self-awareness, promote mental and emotional well-being, and help individuals find inner peace. It's a space where people can connect, explore, and grow.
[D15:14] Jolene:  Your events are awesome for helping people connect and learn, it is so important. How has everything been going for you?
[D15:15] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! It's been great seeing everyone come together and support each other. It's amazing to witness the growth and transformation that happens through these workshops. I'm honored to be a part of it.
[D15:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a game board with a bunch of cards on it
[D15:16] Jolene: Wow, Deb! I can imagine how rewarding it must be to create a space for growth and change. It's great to hear that everything's going well. You can always count on me for support! I just want to share a photo with you.
[D15:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake on a branch with a book
[D15:17] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! Your support means a lot to me. I'm here for you too. By the way, I noticed your pet in the picture. What made you decide to get a snake?
[D15:18] Jolene:  I was fascinated by reptiles, and it felt like the perfect pet for me. Taking care of it has been really calming, and it's a great way to connect with nature.
[D15:19] Deborah:  Glad you found something that gives you peace and calm. Do you have a favorite memory with "it" to share?
[D15:20] Jolene: I have lots of great memories, like our little 'snake adventure'. She got out and I spent hours searching, so relieved when I finally found her snuggling under the bed. It really showed how much I love her.
[D15:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake in a tank with sand and plants
[D15:21] Deborah: What was it like when you found her? I can imagine the relief!
[D15:22] Jolene: Seeing her snuggled under the bed made me feel so much love and gratitude. It made me realize how important she is to me.
[D15:23] Deborah: They bring so much joy and remind us of what's important.
[D15:24] Jolene: Animals teach us a lot about love and gratitude, and they bring so much joy. 
[D15:25] Deborah: I haven't introduced you to my pets yet! I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats.
[D15:25] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket
[D15:26] Jolene: Looks like they're having a blast! How often do you take them out?
[D15:27] Deborah: Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening.
[D15:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D15:28] Jolene: Wow Deb, that's great! I'd love to experience that every day.
[D15:29] Deborah: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!
[D15:30] Jolene: It's a pity that my snakes don't run!  I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun.
[D15:30] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D15:31] Deborah:  It's like hitting a reset button that helps me put things into perspective and gives me time to reflect.
[D15:32] Jolene: Yeah, I totally get it. Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this
[D15:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunset over a body of water
[D15:33] Deborah: It's amazing how nature has the power to bring us peace and clarity.
[D15:34] Jolene: This photo captures the peacefulness of a lake surrounded by trees.
[D15:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dock on a lake with trees in the background
[D15:35] Deborah: Why did you choose that spot? It looks so calm.
[D15:36] Jolene: It's such a hidden gem! It makes me feel so peaceful and tranquil.
[D15:37] Deborah: Lucky you for having somewhere to relax and tune out!
[D15:38] Jolene: We'll definitely go there together sometime!
[D15:39] Deborah: We all need a timeout!
Session date: 9:26 am on 1 August, 2023
[D16:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great news - I just started a project for a cleanup in our community and have been trying to raise funds for it. It's been amazing to see everyone come together to make a difference. How've you been? Anything new going on?
[D16:2] Jolene: Hey Debs! Congrats on your project for the community! As for me, life's been a rollercoaster lately. Last week, I had a huge setback with my project. I put in so much work and it all crashed and I lost everything. SO frustrating and depressing.
[D16:3] Deborah: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?
[D16:4] Jolene: Your support means a lot. Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company. Video games have also been a nice distraction.
[D16:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man holding a snake on his arm
[D16:5] Deborah: They can really provide love and comfort, especially during tough times. How did you come to have Susie?
[D16:6] Jolene: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
[D16:7] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Animals sure have a way of bringing us happiness. They understand us and provide us with comfort. Plus, having a pet teaches us responsibility. She came at the perfect time - cherish those moments with her and find strength in her presence.
[D16:8] Jolene: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.
[D16:9] Deborah: Enjoying the little things is key. Those little moments can give us a boost and push us forward. How have you been taking care of yourself lately?

[D23:3] Jolene: This country was awesome! It showed me different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, which made me appreciate it even more. We visited a lot of delicious cafes! Have you ever been somewhere that was important to you?

[D23:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man standing in front of a house
[D23:5] Jolene: What was it like?
[D23:6] Deborah: It brought back fond memories as I relaxed outside.
[D23:7] Jolene: Sounds great! So glad you have a place to relax and find peace.
[D23:8] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene. It's special for me. How about you? Is there a place that helps you relax?
[D23:9] Jolene: I go to this nearby place to meditate by a tranquil spot.
[D23:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pond with lily pads and a tree in the background
[D23:10] Deborah: Looks chill. What's been the effect of that?
[D23:11] Jolene: It helps me make sense of everything and relieves stress. It's like a restart.
[D23:12] Deborah: Cool, glad you found a place to chill. We all need that occasionally. This is one of my favorite spots to ponder and let things go.

[D23:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a lake with a few trees in the water
[D23:13] Jolene: Looks great! What made you pick that spot?
[D23:14] Deborah: The soothing vibes and nice views made it ideal for reflecting and letting go.
[D23:15] Jolene: Here is one more photo from Rio de Janeiro. We went on many excursions there.
[D23:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people walking up a set of stairs
[D23:16] Deborah: Wow, those stairs look cool! Where were they taken?
[D23:17] Jolene: We had a great time visiting an old temple. The stairs were amazing!
[D23:18] Deborah: Wow, exploring those temples must have been incredible! Three years ago I was also in Rio de Janeiro, I took a beautiful photo on one of the excursions.
[D23:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a large stone structure with a mountain in the background
[D23:19] Jolene: The architecture and history of it all were really interesting. I'm sure you also liked the places you visited there!
[D23:20] Deborah: Exploring historical places and learning their stories is so fun. It was a great experience. I want to share this photo with you.
[D23:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a hand holding a piece of paper with writing on it
[D23:21] Jolene:  By the way, what did that paper have written on it in the photo?
[D23:22] Deborah: This was written to me by a friend who, unfortunately, will never be able to support me. I miss him here. This quote says"Let go of what no longer serves you."
[D23:23] Jolene: I'm sorry! That's a good reminder to stay focused and let go of what no longer serves us. Remember the quote in my notebook? It also inspires me!
[D23:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a quote on it
[D23:24] Deborah: What other quotes give you strength?
[D23:25] Jolene: I came across this one while browsing and it really hit home with me. It's a great reminder to ditch the negative stuff and focus on growing and being positive.
[D23:25] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a pen and a plant on a table
[D23:26] Deborah: Surrounding ourselves with good stuff and striving to improve is key.
[D23:27] Jolene: Yep, Deborah! It's about creating a good atmosphere to help us grow and improve. By the way, I have a new plant.
[D23:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plant in a pot on a patio
[D23:28] Deborah: What made you pick it?
[D23:29] Jolene: I got this as a reminder to nurture myself and embrace fresh starts.
[D23:30] Deborah: Nice job, Jolene! Take care of yourself and embrace new beginnings.
[D23:31] Jolene: Thanks Deb! Will do. Good talking to you. Take care!
[D23:32] Deborah: Have a great day!
Session date: 2:14 pm on 3 September, 2023
[D24:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, just catching up. I went to a cool event last week with the aim to support each other - pretty inspiring. Have you been connecting with anyone lately?
[D24:2] Jolene: Hey Deb, great to hear from you! I've been focusing on studying and my relationship with my partner. We're taking little trips to the beach, it's a great way to relax. How about you, anything new going on?
[D24:3] Deborah: I was busy too - went to a community meetup last Friday. We shared stories and it was nice to feel how connected we are. It made me think about how important relationships are. How about you, how are things going in that area?
[D24:4] Jolene: I'm really thankful for my significant other right now. It's great to have someone encouraging my goals! How are things with your friends and family? Any updates on that front?
[D24:5] Deborah: Relationships with family and friends are so vital. My yoga pals have been my second family - we've held each other up through a lot. The other day I found this old photo. That was when I first started doing yoga. My mum was my biggest fan and source of motivation. She'd often come to my classes with me.
[D24:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat with two children
[D24:6] Jolene: Our loved ones sure are supportive! When I was 10, my parents got me that and it was the start of my passion for video games.
[D24:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a nintendo game console and a game controller
[D24:7] Deborah: Cool that they shared that with you. Did you learn on your own or did they teach you?
[D24:8] Jolene: I taught myself, but my dad was always supportive and my mom would play games with me. 
[D24:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a nintendo wii game system with a game on the screen
[D24:9] Deborah: That's awesome! Sounds like you had a lot of support from your parents. What was your favorite game to play with mom?
[D24:10] Jolene: One of my favorites was "Monster Hunter: World". The immersive story and open-world gaming are amazing!
[D24:11] Deborah:  It can be so freeing when you get immersed in a game like that. 
[D24:12] Jolene: Yeah! It's my way to de-stress and take a break from life.
[D24:13] Deborah: What's up this month? Anything fun happening for you?
[D24:14] Jolene: Got a lot of finals coming up this month, so I've been studying real hard. It's been quite stressful, but it'll be worth it in the end. Thinking about taking a trip somewhere to relax and recharge afterward.
[D24:15] Deborah: Good luck with it! Let me know if there's anything I can do to assist you.
Session date: 8:31 pm on 6 September, 2023
[D25:1] Jolene: Woohoo! I signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake. Can't wait to share this experience with my partner and learn some new techniques. Sooo excited!
[D25:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a building with a curved roof on a hill
[D25:2] Deborah: That`s awesome! It looks so calm in the pic - I hope you enjoy your experience and learn some new techniques!
[D25:3] Jolene:  It's amazing how something so easy can make such a big difference to our health!
[D25:4] Deborah: Yep, it's become part of my routine now. Can't imagine my life without it.

[D26:8] Jolene:  I can tell you about it if you're interested. It took a bit of experimenting, but it's really helped me.

[D26:10] Jolene: Wanna meet up at that cafe next Monday? Let's try fresh pastries.

[D26:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a cup of coffee in front of a bunch of flowers
[D26:13] Deborah: That pic looks so peaceful. Reminded me of a cool hidden coffee shop near me. Rate it!
[D26:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people sitting at tables in a room

Session date: 2:18 pm on 12 September, 2023
[D27:1] Jolene: Hey Deb! So sorry for the late reply, been super busy. Last weekend my partner and I traveled to a meditation retreat for a few weeks in Phuket. Amazing experience! Nature, reflection and a break from engineering studies were awesome - it helped me find inner peace.
[D27:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D27:2] Deborah:  I'd love to hear more about your reflections there and how they changed you.
[D27:3] Jolene: At the retreat, I had time to reflect on what makes me happy. It made me realize the importance of incorporating relaxation, self-care, and balance in life alongside my engineering studies. The beauty of nature there was so inspiring and refreshing!
[D27:4] Deborah:  Was there anything from the retreat that stood out to you?
[D27:5] Jolene: The one session that really stood out was about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present. It was a strong reminder to not just dwell on the finish line, but to appreciate the journey too. I usually get too consumed with hitting my goals that I forget to appreciate the ride.
[D27:6] Deborah:  I've been thinking about this a lot, too. Life's full of small moments and being grateful for those can really boost our happiness.

[D27:8] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Practicing mindfulness and gratitude can really change our day-to-day. Even just a different outlook can make the little things in life joyful. Glad you're getting into it!
[D27:9] Jolene: I'm experiencing a new level of joy and happiness!
[D27:10] Deborah:  It's wonderful to see your progress, and I'm excited to be on this journey with you!
[D27:11] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Appreciate your support. It's great that we can do this together.
[D27:12] Deborah: Having a supportive community definitely helps. We can motivate and encourage each other! By the way, I recently played a game. I don't remember what it's called. This is a card game about cats, where you take cards one by one from a deck, and then you can attack your opponent with them. We'll definitely play it with you!
[D27:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two children standing on yoga mats in a room
[D27:13] Jolene: I look forward to meeting you and playing this game!

[D16:10] Jolene: I'm trying to prioritize self-care, like yoga and meditation. It helps me stay balanced and grounded.
[D16:11] Deborah:  If you're interested, I can suggest some routines for you to try.

[D16:13] Deborah: In the meantime, check out this great place for yoga.
[D16:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a lot of yoga mats on the floor

[D16:15] Deborah: One of my favorite yoga routines is a gentle flow that's all about breathing and grounding. It helps me find my chill. I'll send you a tutorial video with the poses. This is me in the process :)
[D16:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a pink shirt doing a yoga pose
[D16:16] Jolene: Wow! Does that help you find your chill or improve your concentration?
[D16:17] Deborah: It's a great way to find balance in tough times. Try it out and let me know what you think!

[D16:19] Deborah: Let me know how it goes. Talk to you later!

Session date: 8:50 pm on 12 August, 2023
[D17:1] Deborah: Since we last spoke, I made a meditation guide for my yoga retreat. How about you?
[D17:2] Jolene: I have been stressed since I lost my work files. I was so overwhelmed...but meditation kept me chill and I got my clarity back, thank goodness. Really appreciate the practice!
[D17:3] Deborah: It's amazing how it can give you peace and calm in times like that. If you ever need any support, just let me know - we're in this together!
[D17:4] Jolene:  Appreciate your support! BTW, I wanted to share this with you.
[D17:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two notebooks with a blue cover and a white strip
[D17:5] Deborah: Your creativity is amazing! 
[D17:6] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! I was inspired by my love for space and engines, so I designed these notebooks with elements like galaxies and circuitry. I think they turned out really cool!
[D17:7] Deborah: You have such a knack for turning these into art. They make me feel excited just by looking at them. Your creativity is amazing! Does that usually inspire your engineering projects too?
[D17:8] Jolene: Seeing art and design in various things gives me a unique perspective on problems.
[D17:9] Deborah: Got any neat projects or ideas you're pumped about?
[D17:10] Jolene:  Working on a cool project now - a prototype that could revolutionize aerial surveillance. Can't wait to see the results!
[D17:11] Deborah: I admire your ambition to make a difference. Do you have any specific plans or goals for this project?
[D17:12] Jolene: My aim is to devise a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system. It'll help with responding to emergencies and monitoring the environment. It'll make the world a better, safer place.
[D17:13] Deborah: I love your commitment. Keep going!
[D17:14] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing and doing my best to make a difference.
[D17:15] Deborah: You got this!
Session date: 2:58 pm on 16 August, 2023
[D18:1] Jolene: Been thinking a lot about my plans lately, especially after checking in with my bf. It's been up and down!  Some days it feels like I'm trying to juggle my engineering, relationship, and growing as a person, and I just don't know how to handle it all. How do you manage when it's too much?
[D18:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book with a checklist on it
[D18:2] Deborah: Finding ways to restore balance is important. Taking time for yourself and recognizing your needs can make a difference. 
[D18:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a moss wall and a floor cushion
[D18:3] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! I've been trying out some time management strategies recently and started using a bullet journal. It's been really helpful for tracking my tasks and staying organized.
[D18:4] Deborah:  It's great to hear that it's been helping you out!
[D18:5] Jolene:  Not only does it help me stay on top of everything, but it's also so satisfying when I cross tasks off my list. Here's a pic of my newest spread with one of my favorite quotes.
[D18:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a quote on it
[D18:6] Deborah: I love this quote. So uplifting. Does it motivate you when you see it?
[D18:7] Jolene: Yeah, it's like a little reminder to stick to my goals and never give up.
[D18:8] Deborah: Gotcha! Visual reminders like this photo can be super motivating. Keep focusing on your goals, Jolene, and don't give up! I led a meditation yoga sessionto the elderly at a local care home last week during sunset. Nature can be really helpful for finding peace. Have you tried mindfulness too? 
[D18:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga on a beach
[D18:9] Jolene: Haven't tried it yet, but I'm keen to give it a shot. That sounds really peaceful. I could use some of that calm in my life right now.  I'm interested in destressing and trying mindfulness. 
[D18:10] Deborah: I started with workshops and books, and now mindfulness is a huge part of my life.
[D18:11] Jolene:  I'll definitely look into some of it. Can't wait to get started!
[D18:12] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! I'm so glad you're willing to try some mindfulness. It can be really helpful. Let me know if you need any help getting started - I'm happy to assist you with your journey!
[D18:13] Jolene:  I really appreciate it.
[D18:14] Deborah: We're in this together. Give me a shout if you need anything. Bye for now.
[D18:15] Jolene: Thanks, I'll hit you up if I need anything. Bye for now.
Session date: 12:52 am on 19 August, 2023
[D19:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Hope you're having a good one. Last Friday I told Anna the story of my life and they were super kind about it. It was so nice to have a meaningful connection. How's the mindfulness workshops and reading going? Need any help?
[D19:2] Jolene: Life's been hella busy since we last talked. I bought a console for my partner as a gift on the 17th and it's so much fun, he even managed to play it.! Engineering studies are still going strong too. Balance has been key for me lately. How about you? What's been up?
[D19:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a black xbox console with a yoda yoda figure next to it
[D19:3] Deborah:  Well done! As for me, I've been focusing on teaching yoga and spending time with the community. Organizing a yoga event last month was really cool.
[D19:4] Jolene:  Was it rewarding seeing everyone come together? Can you tell me more about how you put it together? Also, any tips for maintaining a balance between hobbies and studies?
[D19:5] Deborah:  I reached out to different nearby businesses and places to make it happen. We had yoga, food stalls, and even some live music - it was amazing! As for balancing hobbies and studies, I find it helpful to prioritize and manage my time effectively. Making a schedule and setting aside specific time for studying and pursuing hobbies can go a long way in maintaining balance.
[D19:6] Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! Gonna make a plan to manage my studies and hobbies. Say, do you ever play video games?
[D19:7] Deborah: I used to play some video games, but it's been a while. It's a good way to relax after a busy day. Do you have any game suggestions? What's your favorite game?
